requires: Monk level 5, Way of the Long Death subclass
unlock: On floor 9 of the Milestone Spire an old temple bell tolls once for every creature that dies on that floor; ring it yourself by striking it barehanded after each kill, never missing a toll.
secret: You must have sat a full night beside a dying stranger before entering, saying nothing.
notice: [The bell answered your hand. Hidden job change: Bell-Ringer of the Last Hour.]
blurb: A death-monk who hears a faint bell over every creature close to dying and strikes on the toll.
features: Skill: Hear the Toll
You know when a creature within 60 feet is below half its hit points. Your first unarmed hit each turn against such a creature deals an extra 1d8 necrotic damage.
Skill: Echoing Peal
When a creature you hit drops to 0 hit points, you gain temporary hit points equal to your Monk level and regain 1 ki point.
Ultimate: The Final Hour Strikes
Once per long rest, choose a creature below a quarter of its hit points within reach: it makes a Constitution save or drops to 0 hit points.
evolves: At level 15, after ringing the bell for 100 deaths, its toll can be heard by allies, who gain advantage on attacks against tolled foes.
cost: Each night you hear the bell for anyone dying within a mile and cannot sleep until it stops.

requires: Monk level 11, Way of the Long Death subclass; holds a Death or Grim Reaper Rune shard
unlock: In the Fogglass Spire a grey river crosses floor 12; pole a ferry of strangers' ghosts to the far bank and refuse every coin they offer.
secret: At least one ghost must be someone you killed, and you must carry them across without striking them.
notice: [The fare is waived. The ferry has a new lantern. Hidden job: Lantern-Keeper of the Grey Ferry.]
blurb: A death-monk who walks the border river between life and the after, guiding the dead and hauling the living back across.
features: Skill: Ferry Lantern
As a bonus action you light a grey lantern; undead and spirits within 20 feet have disadvantage on attacks against you and your allies.
Skill: Fare Unpaid
When an ally within 30 feet drops to 0 hit points, spend 3 ki to pull them back to hit points equal to your Monk level.
Ultimate: Cross the River
Once per long rest, you and up to four allies step onto the grey river for 1 minute: you are ethereal, resist all damage, and can strike creatures on the material side.
evolves: At level 21, after ferrying 50 souls, the lantern can carry one dead ally back across within 1 hour of death.
cost: The dead can always find you, and many come asking for passage.

requires: Monk level 21, Way of the Long Death subclass; Senior contract with Morrigan
unlock: On the Ledger Spire's 22nd floor a battlefield of the unburied waits; give every corpse its rites before a flock of crows picks it clean.
secret: You must offer Morrigan one of your own memories of a loved one, written down and burned on the field.
notice: [A crow lands on your shoulder and does not leave. Hidden job: Morrigan's Crow-Fisted Mourner.]
blurb: A death-monk sworn to the goddess of fate, fighting in a storm of black feathers and choosing who falls.
features: Skill: Crow Count
At the start of combat you mark one creature as fated; your unarmed hits against it are critical on a 19 or 20.
Skill: Feathered Flurry
Your Flurry of Blows makes three strikes instead of two, and each hit can blind the target until your next turn (Constitution save).
Ultimate: The Goddess Chooses
Once per long rest, every creature you choose within 60 feet below half hit points makes a Wisdom save or drops to 0 hit points as crows descend.
evolves: At level 31, if you reach Apostle with Morrigan, your crows can carry you as a flock, teleporting 120 feet.
cost: Morrigan claims one kill each day as her own; that kill grants you nothing.

requires: Monk level 5, Way of the Open Hand subclass
unlock: Floor 7 of the Milestone Spire holds a boulder blocking the stair; move it out of the way using only open-palm strikes, no shoving or tools.
secret: You must have knocked prone at least 100 creatures with your bare hands before the attempt.
notice: [The stone rolls aside. The palm remembers. Hidden job change: Palm That Moves Mountains.]
blurb: An Open Hand monk who stops being clever and simply pushes: everything they hit goes somewhere else.
features: Skill: Rolling Palm
Flurry of Blows hits that push a target can push it 20 feet instead of 15, and a target pushed into a wall or creature takes 1d10 bludgeoning damage.
Skill: Uproot
Creatures you push cannot use reactions until the end of their next turn, and Large targets can be pushed as if Medium.
Ultimate: Mountain Shift
Once per long rest, a single palm strike pushes every creature in a 30 foot line 40 feet and knocks them prone (Strength save negates the prone).
evolves: At level 15, after pushing a Huge creature off a ledge, you can push Huge targets as easily as Medium.
cost: Your hands cannot grip a weapon for more than one attack per turn.

requires: Monk level 11, Way of the Open Hand subclass; Balance or Serenity Rune shard
unlock: In the Fogglass Spire a pond floor reflects the room upside down; fight your reflection without letting a single ripple form on the water.
secret: You must win with no damage dealt, only trips, shoves and disarms.
notice: [The water does not move. Neither did you. Hidden job: Weaver of Still Water.]
blurb: An Open Hand monk who turns every attack back on its owner, flowing around blows like water around stone.
features: Skill: Still Surface
When a melee attack misses you, the attacker makes a Dexterity save or falls prone.
Skill: Return the Current
When you Deflect or dodge an attack, spend 1 ki to make the attacker hit itself with half the damage it would have dealt.
Ultimate: Mirror Pond
Once per long rest for 1 minute, every melee attack against you has disadvantage and each miss lets you make one unarmed strike as a free action.
evolves: At level 21, if you finish a Tower floor without taking damage, your reflection fights beside you once per day.
cost: You cannot make the first attack in a fight; you must wait to be struck at.

requires: Monk level 21, Way of the Open Hand subclass; Alchemy or Cooking profession level 10
unlock: On the Choir Spire's 21st floor a ward of wounded angels waits; heal every one by setting their bones by hand, no spells.
secret: You must have mended at least 200 broken bones in the Mortal Realm, friend or foe.
notice: [The ward is quiet. Every bone is straight. Hidden job: Bonesetter of the Open Hand.]
blurb: An Open Hand monk who learned that the hand that breaks also mends, and fights by knowing exactly where the body bends.
features: Skill: Pressure Map
Your unarmed strikes ignore 2 points of the target's AC reduction, and you can spend 1 ki to stun on a hit instead of 2.
Skill: Setting Hand
As a bonus action touch an ally to restore hit points equal to your martial arts die rolled three times and end one condition.
Ultimate: Unmake the Frame
Once per long rest, a touch that hits forces a Constitution save; on a failure the target's speed is 0, it cannot take reactions and has disadvantage on all attacks for 1 minute.
evolves: At level 31, after setting the bones of a god's servant, your Setting Hand can restore a lost limb.
cost: You must treat any wounded creature who asks, enemy or not, after a fight ends.

requires: Monk level 5, Way of the Sun Soul subclass
unlock: Floor 6 of the Milestone Spire is a dark maze; burn your way out with radiant bolts alone before the torches on the walls can be lit by anyone else.
secret: You must have watched a full sunrise from start to end for 30 days in a row.
notice: [It is always noon in your hands. Hidden job change: Noonday Fist.]
blurb: A Sun Soul monk who stops throwing light and starts holding it, every punch a small midday.
features: Skill: Held Noon
Your unarmed strikes deal radiant damage and shed bright light; the first hit each turn adds 1d6 radiant.
Skill: No Shadow at Noon
Creatures you hit cannot be invisible or hidden until your next turn and lose resistance to radiant damage.
Ultimate: High Sun
Once per long rest, for 1 minute your Flurry of Blows strikes each deal an extra 2d6 radiant damage and creatures you hit are blinded until your next turn (Constitution save).
evolves: At level 15, after striking a creature of the Dark in its own lair, your fists stay lit even in magical darkness.
cost: You glow faintly at all times; stealth checks have disadvantage.

requires: Monk level 11, Way of the Sun Soul subclass; Normal contract with Ra
unlock: On the Choir Spire's 21st floor, row Ra's boat across a night river while serpents strike at the hull; do not stop rowing until dawn.
secret: You must not lift a hand to fight the serpents; only the light you shed may harm them.
notice: [Dawn arrives on time. The sun god nods. Hidden job: Ra's Solar Oarsman.]
blurb: A Sun Soul monk who rows the sun through the dark each night in the god's service, carrying day wherever they go.
features: Skill: Night Crossing
You see in darkness to 120 feet, and darkness spells you are in end at the start of your turn.
Skill: Serpent-Breaking Oar
Your Sunbolt can be thrown as a 60 foot line, dealing its damage to every creature in it (Dexterity save for half).
Ultimate: Dawn on Time
Once per long rest, you call sunlight in a 60 foot radius for 1 minute: undead and fiends there take 4d8 radiant damage at the start of each of their turns.
evolves: At level 21, if you reach Senior with Ra, the boat can carry your party between realms at dawn.
cost: You must spend every sunset in silent prayer to Ra or lose your contract spells for a day.

requires: Monk level 21, Way of the Sun Soul subclass; Sun or Star Rune shard
unlock: In the Shuffled Spire a floor has no sun at all; hang in its sky as its sun for one hour while its creatures try to put you out.
secret: You must have fasted for 7 days, eating only light, before you climb.
notice: [A dark spot crosses your light. Hidden job: Sunspot Ascetic.]
blurb: A Sun Soul monk who found the dark spots on the sun and learned to burn with them: light that flares unpredictably and devours.
features: Skill: Flare
Once per turn, when you roll the highest number on a radiant damage die, roll it again and add it.
Skill: Sunspot Burn
Creatures you hit with radiant damage cannot regain hit points until the start of your next turn.
Ultimate: Corona Collapse
Once per long rest, you burst into a 30 foot sphere of sunfire: 10d10 radiant damage (Constitution save for half), and you take 2d10 fire damage.
evolves: At level 31, if you survive a Corona Collapse at 1 hit point, it can be used twice per long rest.
cost: Water and ice spells deal double damage to you.

requires: Paladin level 5, Oath of Ash subclass
unlock: On floor 8 of the Milestone Spire a field of blight spreads each round; burn all of it with smites before it reaches the stairs.
secret: You must have burned down a building you once lived in or loved.
notice: [Only ash remains. Ash grows the best crops. Hidden job change: Cinder-Warden of the Burnt Field.]
blurb: An Oath of Ash paladin who burns so the land can regrow: fire that lingers, then feeds.
features: Skill: Lingering Cinder
Your smites leave cinders on the target, dealing 1d6 fire damage at the start of each of its turns for 1 minute or until it spends an action to beat them out.
Skill: Ash Feeds
When a creature with your cinders dies, you and allies within 10 feet regain hit points equal to your Charisma modifier plus your Paladin level.
Ultimate: Firebreak
Once per long rest, you burn a 20 foot wide line 60 feet long into the ground; creatures crossing it take 4d10 fire damage and cannot pass without a Strength save.
evolves: At level 15, after cleansing a blighted village with fire, crops grown from your ash ripen in a day.
cost: Wood and cloth you touch for long begin to char; you go through gear quickly.

requires: Paladin level 11, Oath of Ash subclass; Fire or Punish Rune shard
unlock: On the Ledger Spire's 21st floor every plaque lists a debt; burn the plaques of the unjust creditors while leaving the honest ones untouched.
secret: You must read every name before you burn it, aloud.
notice: [The ledger smokes. Some debts are better burned. Hidden job: Ashen Ledger-Keeper.]
blurb: An Oath of Ash paladin who burns away contracts, curses and bonds as easily as flesh.
features: Skill: Burn the Seal
Your smites can target a curse, charm or magical bond on a creature you touch, ending it if its level is equal or lower than your spell slot.
Skill: Smoldering Name
Speak a creature's true name while smiting to deal an extra 3d6 fire damage that cannot be reduced by resistance.
Ultimate: Debt Burned
Once per long rest, a creature you hit makes a Charisma save or every contract, pact and bond it holds is suspended for 1 hour.
evolves: At level 21, after burning a devil's contract with the devil still holding it, Hell's creditors cannot claim your debts.
cost: Devils know your face and add your name to their own ledgers.

requires: Paladin level 21, Oath of Ash subclass; Blacksmithing profession level 10; Senior contract with Brigid
unlock: On the Choir Spire's 23rd floor a cold forge waits; light it with your own smite and reforge a broken holy blade before the choir ends its hymn.
secret: The blade must belong to an enemy paladin you defeated, and you must return it to their kin afterward.
notice: [The forge is warm again. Brigid hums along. Hidden job: Kiln-Sworn of Brigid.]
blurb: An Oath of Ash paladin who serves the goddess of the forge and the hearth, turning scorched ruin into tempered steel.
features: Skill: Kiln Blade
Your weapon is heated as a forge; it deals an extra 2d6 fire damage and you can reshape or repair metal by touch.
Skill: Temper the Faithful
After a short rest, allies' metal weapons and armor gain +1 to hit or +1 AC until the next rest.
Ultimate: Brigid's Hearth
Once per long rest for 1 minute, you burn as a sacred forge: allies within 20 feet regain 2d8 hit points each turn and enemies there take 3d8 fire damage.
evolves: At level 31, if you reach Apostle with Brigid, weapons you forge carry a sliver of her Rune.
cost: You must keep a hearth fire lit somewhere in your name; if it goes out, you lose your Kiln Blade for a day.

requires: Paladin level 5, Oath of Conquest subclass
unlock: On floor 10 of the Milestone Spire raise your own banner over a fortress full of goblin raiders and hold it for 3 rounds.
secret: You must have made at least 20 enemies surrender in battle without killing them.
notice: [The banner stands. Below it, they kneel. Hidden job change: Iron Banner-Lord.]
blurb: A Conquest paladin who plants a banner and claims the ground around it: enemies there feel the weight of a lost war.
features: Skill: Plant the Banner
As a bonus action, plant a banner; enemies within 20 feet have disadvantage on saves against being frightened.
Skill: Held Ground
You and allies within the banner's area cannot be pushed and gain +1 AC.
Ultimate: Total Surrender
Once per long rest, every frightened enemy within the banner's area makes a Wisdom save or drops its weapons and surrenders for 1 minute.
evolves: At level 15, after taking a keep, the banner can be planted there permanently and its terror spreads across the whole keep.
cost: If an enemy pulls up your banner, you are frightened of them until your next long rest.

requires: Paladin level 11, Oath of Conquest subclass; Fear or Sovereignty Rune shard
unlock: In the Fogglass Spire an empty throne sits in mist; sit in it and keep it while the floor's ghosts each try to drag you out.
secret: You must win by fear alone; no ghost can be destroyed.
notice: [The throne is yours. The fog bows. Hidden job: Tyrant of the Fogged Throne.]
blurb: A Conquest paladin who rules through dread, wrapping the battlefield in a mist of terror.
features: Skill: Throne Mist
As an action you fill a 30 foot radius with mist that only you see through; frightened creatures in it cannot move toward you.
Skill: Kneel
When a frightened creature starts its turn within 10 feet of you, it falls prone and takes 2d8 psychic damage.
Ultimate: The Throne Speaks
Once per long rest, every creature in your mist makes a Wisdom save or becomes frightened for 1 minute and must obey one-word commands from you.
evolves: At level 21, if you rule a real territory for a season, your mist can cover an entire town.
cost: Animals and children flee from you.

requires: Paladin level 21, Oath of Conquest subclass; Senior contract with Odin
unlock: In the Sunken Spire command an army of drowned soldiers across three floors and win without stepping in the water yourself.
secret: You must sacrifice something you value equal to an eye, given willingly and permanently.
notice: [The Allfather counts your dead and approves. Hidden job: Odin's Iron Field-Marshal.]
blurb: A Conquest paladin who commands armies for the Allfather, buying victory with costly wisdom.
features: Skill: War Council
Allies within 60 feet who can hear you add your Charisma modifier to initiative and to their first attack each round.
Skill: Spear of Command
As a bonus action, order an ally to make one weapon attack as a reaction with advantage.
Ultimate: Host of the Fallen
Once per long rest, summon a host of 10 spectral fallen warriors (use veteran stats) that fight under your command for 1 minute.
evolves: At level 31, if you reach Apostle with Odin, your host can be summoned twice per day and includes ravens that scout for you.
cost: You must give one honest piece of wisdom to anyone who asks, even an enemy.

requires: Paladin level 5, Oath of Devotion subclass
unlock: On floor 5 of the Milestone Spire guard a single candle through a storm of wind spirits; it must not go out.
secret: You must never have told a lie since taking your oath, not even a kind one.
notice: [The flame did not flicker. Hidden job change: Candle of the Unbroken Vow.]
blurb: A Devotion paladin who carries a holy candle that cannot be put out while their vows hold.
features: Skill: Vow Flame
A candle burns on your shield or helm; allies within 10 feet cannot be charmed.
Skill: Honest Light
Creatures in your candle's light cannot lie, and invisible creatures within 10 feet are outlined.
Ultimate: The Candle Holds
Once per long rest, when an ally within 30 feet would drop to 0 hit points, they drop to 1 instead and regain hit points equal to your Paladin level.
evolves: At level 15, after keeping the candle lit through a Tower's darkness floor, it brightens to 30 feet.
cost: If you ever lie, the candle goes out and does not relight until you confess publicly.

requires: Paladin level 11, Oath of Devotion subclass; Protect or Divinity Rune shard
unlock: On the Choir Spire's 21st floor a gate is under siege; hold it alone for 10 rounds while refugees pass through behind you.
secret: Not one refugee may be harmed, and you may not take a single step forward.
notice: [The gate held. The choir sings your name. Hidden job: Shield-Saint of the Choir Gate.]
blurb: A Devotion paladin who becomes a holy wall, a living gate nothing evil can pass.
features: Skill: Gate Stance
While you have not moved this turn, enemies cannot move past you within 10 feet without succeeding on a Strength save.
Skill: Saint's Wall
When an ally within 15 feet is hit, use your reaction to take the hit instead and reduce its damage by your Charisma modifier.
Ultimate: No Evil Passes
Once per long rest, a 30 foot wall of radiant light appears for 1 minute; fiends and undead cannot cross it and take 6d8 radiant damage trying.
evolves: At level 21, after guarding a real city gate through a siege, your wall can be raised as a dome.
cost: You can never retreat from a battle where innocents remain.

requires: Paladin level 21, Oath of Devotion subclass; Senior contract with Baldur
unlock: On the Choir Spire's 23rd floor every weapon on the floor swings at you in turn; let each one strike and bless the one that does not.
secret: One weapon is made of mistletoe; you must find it and make peace with it rather than destroy it.
notice: [Nothing wounds you that you have forgiven. Hidden job: Baldur's Unwounded Champion.]
blurb: A Devotion paladin blessed by the god of light so that weapons are reluctant to harm them, save one weakness.
features: Skill: Beloved of All Things
Nonmagical weapons deal no damage to you, and magical weapons deal 2d6 less damage.
Skill: Light of Baldur
Your aura grants allies resistance to radiant and necrotic damage and +1 AC.
Ultimate: Shining Death
Once per long rest, when you drop to 0 hit points, you explode in light: 10d8 radiant damage to enemies within 30 feet and allies regain the same.
evolves: At level 31, if you reach Apostle with Baldur, even your one weakness only deals normal damage.
cost: Pick one plant: weapons made of or coated with it deal triple damage to you.

requires: Paladin level 5, Oath of Eternity subclass
unlock: On floor 9 of the Milestone Spire, stand on a single tile for 10 rounds while the floor crumbles; you must still be standing at the end.
secret: You must have been at 0 hit points and kept fighting through the Oath's power at least 10 times.
notice: [You did not fall. The tile did not fall. Hidden job change: Stone of the Last Stand.]
blurb: An Eternity paladin who refuses to fall harder than any other: they become the last stone left standing.
features: Skill: Final Tile
While you are at or below half your hit points, you cannot be pushed or knocked prone.
Skill: Hard Remain
When you use your Oath to stay up at 0 hit points, gain temporary hit points equal to your Paladin level.
Ultimate: The Stone Stands
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you cannot drop below 1 hit point, and every hit you take adds 1d6 to your next smite.
evolves: At level 15, after being the last one standing in a party wipe, your Hard Remain also heals one ally.
cost: You cannot rest until every ally is safe; you get no benefit from a short rest while any ally is wounded.

requires: Paladin level 11, Oath of Eternity subclass; Time or Always Rune shard
unlock: In the Fogglass Spire a floor resets every minute; carry an hourglass through 60 resets without letting it break.
secret: Each reset, you must remember and speak aloud everything that happened before.
notice: [The hourglass turns at your command. Hidden job: Hourglass Templar.]
blurb: An Eternity paladin who outlasts by bending time itself, stretching moments so they never end.
features: Skill: Stretched Moment
Once per round, when you would drop to 0 hit points, roll a d20; on 10 or higher you take the damage at the end of the round instead.
Skill: Turn the Glass
Spend a spell slot to undo the last attack against an ally; it is rerolled.
Ultimate: Eternal Instant
Once per long rest, freeze time around you for 1 round: you take one full extra turn while others stand still.
evolves: At level 21, after spending a year inside the Fogglass Spire, you can restart a single fight round once per day.
cost: You age a day for every hour you stretch; your hair turns grey early.

requires: Paladin level 21, Oath of Eternity subclass; Senior contract with Osiris
unlock: In the Sunken Spire gather the 14 scattered pieces of a broken guardian and rebuild him before he dissolves into the deep.
secret: You must have died and been resurrected at least once.
notice: [The god of rebirth hands you back your life. Hidden job: Osiris's Undying Warden.]
blurb: An Eternity paladin who serves the god who came back, rising again and again from death.
features: Skill: Rebirth Wrap
When you die, you return to life at the end of your next turn with half your hit points, once per long rest.
Skill: Green Skin of Renewal
You regain hit points equal to your Charisma modifier at the start of each of your turns while above 0.
Ultimate: Judgment of the Weighed Heart
Once per long rest, a creature you touch makes a Charisma save; on a failure it takes 12d10 necrotic damage, half on a success, and cannot be resurrected for a week.
evolves: At level 31, if you reach Apostle with Osiris, you can share your Rebirth Wrap with one ally.
cost: Each time you return from death, you forget one face you once knew.

requires: Paladin level 5, Oath of Glory subclass
unlock: On floor 10 of the Milestone Spire a bard waits for a hero worth singing about; defeat the floor's boss in a way the bard calls a story.
secret: At least three songs must already be sung about you in taverns, written by others.
notice: [You are in the song now. Hidden job change: Ballad-Bound Hero.]
blurb: A Glory paladin whose deeds become ballads, and whose ballads make them stronger.
features: Skill: Verse in Progress
Each turn you land a critical hit or defeat a foe, gain one Verse (max 5); each Verse adds +1 to your attack rolls.
Skill: Chorus
Spend all Verses as a bonus action to give allies within 30 feet temporary hit points equal to 5 times the Verses spent.
Ultimate: The Hero's Last Verse
Once per long rest, gain 5 Verses at once and your next hit is a critical hit that deals an extra 6d8 radiant damage.
evolves: At level 15, when your ballad is sung in three different cities, your Verses carry over between fights.
cost: If you flee a fight, your ballad becomes a mocking song and you lose all Verses for a week.

requires: Paladin level 11, Oath of Glory subclass; Normal contract with Tyche
unlock: In the Shuffled Spire the trial is decided by a coin toss; win 7 tosses in a row by daring the coin, not cheating it.
secret: You must bet something precious on each toss and keep nothing you win.
notice: [Fortune smiles. She does not always. Hidden job: Tyche's Lucky Champion.]
blurb: A Glory paladin who chases legend with luck, betting glory on the roll of the dice.
features: Skill: Coin of Fortune
Once per turn, reroll any d20 you make; you must use the second roll.
Skill: Lucky Smite
When you smite, roll a d6; on a 6 the smite uses no spell slot.
Ultimate: Fortune's Favorite
Once per long rest, for 1 minute every d20 you roll below 10 counts as 10.
evolves: At level 21, if you reach Senior with Tyche, you can grant Coin of Fortune to one ally.
cost: Once per day the DM may declare one of your rolls a 1.

requires: Paladin level 21, Oath of Glory subclass; Senior contract with Helios
unlock: On the Choir Spire's 22nd floor, drive the sun chariot across the sky without falling, as an old story says one boy could not.
secret: You must have rescued a whole town from a disaster at some point in your life.
notice: [You held the reins. The sun shines on you. Hidden job: Sun-Crowned Legend of Helios.]
blurb: A Glory paladin who rides beside the sun god's chariot, every heroic deed shining across the sky.
features: Skill: Sun Chariot
You can summon a burning chariot as your mount; it flies at 60 feet and deals 3d8 fire damage to creatures it passes through.
Skill: Glory Under the Sun
In daylight, you and allies within 30 feet gain advantage on Strength and Charisma checks and saves.
Ultimate: Noonday Charge
Once per long rest, you charge up to 300 feet in a straight line; every creature in the path takes 10d10 radiant damage (Dexterity save for half).
evolves: At level 31, if you reach Apostle with Helios, the chariot can carry your whole party across a realm in a day.
cost: Your power weakens at night: smites deal half damage after dark.

requires: Paladin level 5, Oath of Redemption subclass
unlock: On floor 7 of the Milestone Spire a fallen knight wanders; talk them into retaking their oath without fighting them.
secret: You must have forgiven someone who caused you real harm before entering.
notice: [The knight kneels and rises again. Hidden job change: Mender of Broken Oaths.]
blurb: A Redemption paladin who helps others retake their oaths, giving second chances by hand.
features: Skill: Second Chance
Once per short rest, an enemy that surrenders to you heals to half its hit points and cannot attack you for 1 hour.
Skill: Shared Vow
A redeemed creature can fight beside you; it gains +1 AC and +1 to attack while within 30 feet of you.
Ultimate: Mended Oath
Once per long rest, a hostile creature within 30 feet makes a Charisma save or turns to your side for 1 hour.
evolves: At level 15, if a creature you redeemed becomes a paladin, you can share your aura with them across any distance.
cost: If a redeemed creature turns on you, you lose this job's features for a week.

requires: Paladin level 11, Oath of Redemption subclass; Cooking profession level 7
unlock: In the Fogglass Spire cook a meal for a monster that has eaten travelers, and convince it to eat yours instead.
secret: The monster must leave the Tower alive and never return to killing.
notice: [It ate. It did not hunt. Hidden job: Penitent of the Grey Hearth.]
blurb: A Redemption paladin who heals hatred with hospitality: a warm meal is a spell.
features: Skill: Shared Bread
A meal you cook for a creature makes it unable to attack you for 24 hours, unless you attack first.
Skill: Hearthfire Aura
Enemies within 10 feet of you have disadvantage on attacks against creatures that have eaten your food today.
Ultimate: Feast of Peace
Once per long rest, set a feast as an action; every creature within 60 feet must make a Wisdom save or stop fighting for 1 minute to eat.
evolves: At level 21, after feeding 100 enemies, your meals can also heal curses.
cost: You must carry and cook with only food you made or harvested yourself.

requires: Paladin level 21, Oath of Redemption subclass; Senior contract with Forseti
unlock: On the Choir Spire's 21st floor two angel armies are about to clash; broker a peace before the first blow lands.
secret: Neither side may lose any member, and you must not lie to either side.
notice: [The armies part. Peace is signed in light. Hidden job: Forseti's Peace-Herald.]
blurb: A Redemption paladin serving the god of reconciliation, ending fights through law and truth.
features: Skill: Herald's Ring
When combat begins, creatures within 60 feet must make a Wisdom save or be unable to attack for 1 round.
Skill: Fair Judgment
Hostile creatures that hit you take radiant damage equal to half the damage they dealt.
Ultimate: Grand Reconciliation
Once per long rest, every creature within 120 feet makes a Charisma save or stops fighting for 1 hour and talks peace.
evolves: At level 31, if you reach Apostle with Forseti, you can end wars between nations by speaking at their councils.
cost: You must always offer surrender before battle.

requires: Paladin level 5, Oath of Silence subclass
unlock: On floor 6 of the Milestone Spire cross a hall of sleeping guards; kill the floor's boss without waking a single one.
secret: You must have spoken no word for an entire week before entering.
notice: [The hall did not stir. Hidden job change: Hushblade of the Empty Hall.]
blurb: A Silence paladin who makes no sound at all; their smites land as quiet as snow.
features: Skill: Silent Step
You make no sound when you move or fight, and have advantage on stealth checks.
Skill: Hushed Smite
Your smites silence the target for 1 round; it cannot cast verbal spells.
Ultimate: Empty Hall
Once per long rest, for 1 minute a 30 foot radius around you is silent; you and allies there are invisible to creatures outside it.
evolves: At level 15, after crossing a whole Tower floor without making any sound, your silence can travel with you as an aura.
cost: You cannot speak while using any of this job's features.

requires: Paladin level 11, Oath of Silence subclass; Mask or Shade Rune shard
unlock: In the Fogglass Spire a pale mask hangs over a stair; wear it for one hour through the floor without removing it or speaking.
secret: The mask whispers secrets to you; you must keep every one of them.
notice: [The mask fits. The vow seals. Hidden job: Vow-Mute of the Pale Mask.]
blurb: A Silence paladin who hides behind a pale mask, unseen and unknown, judging in secret.
features: Skill: Faceless
While wearing your mask, divination magic cannot find you and creatures forget your face within an hour.
Skill: Mask Strike
Your first hit on a creature that has not seen you deals an extra 4d8 radiant damage.
Ultimate: Pale Judgment
Once per long rest, a creature you strike makes a Wisdom save or its own guilt overwhelms it: stunned for 1 minute.
evolves: At level 21, after keeping the mask on for a year, it becomes your true face.
cost: You must never reveal your real name to anyone after this job change.

requires: Paladin level 21, Oath of Silence subclass; Senior contract with Nyx
unlock: In the Sunken Spire carry no light through 5 floors of darkness and kill only what you hear, never what you see.
secret: You must have kept a vow of silence for one full moon.
notice: [Night embraces you. You make no sound. Hidden job: Nyx's Quiet Sword.]
blurb: A Silence paladin serving the goddess of night, a blade that appears and vanishes in the dark.
features: Skill: Night Shroud
In dim light or darkness you are invisible unless you attack.
Skill: No Opportunity
Your movement never provokes opportunity attacks, and you can move through enemy spaces.
Ultimate: Night Falls
Once per long rest, you plunge a 60 foot radius into total magical darkness for 1 minute; every hit you land there deals an extra 4d10 necrotic damage.
evolves: At level 31, if you reach Apostle with Nyx, you can step through shadows to any dark place you have seen.
cost: Bright light deals 1d6 radiant damage to you each turn you stand in it.

requires: Paladin level 5, Oath of Vengeance subclass
unlock: On floor 9 of the Milestone Spire a list of names is chained to the wall; find and defeat the three names that wronged you in the Tower before.
secret: You must have kept a written ledger of every wrong done to you or others for a year.
notice: [The ledger closes, but never fully. Hidden job change: Grudge-Keeper of the Black Ledger.]
blurb: A Vengeance paladin who writes down every sin and never forgets a single one.
features: Skill: Writ of Grudge
As a bonus action, write a creature's name; you have advantage on attacks against it for 1 hour.
Skill: Unpaid Debt
Each hit on a written creature deals an extra 1d8 damage for every ally it has hurt today.
Ultimate: Ledger Settled
Once per long rest, when a written creature drops to 0, you regain all spent smite slots of 2nd level or lower.
evolves: At level 15, after settling a grudge older than a decade, you can keep three names written at once.
cost: You can never forgive a creature you have written.

requires: Paladin level 11, Oath of Vengeance subclass; Normal contract with Nemesis
unlock: In the Shuffled Spire a proud king rules a floor; humble him by taking away what he values most, not by killing him.
secret: You must not take anything for yourself from his court.
notice: [Balance is restored. Nemesis nods. Hidden job: Thorn of Nemesis.]
blurb: A Vengeance paladin serving the goddess of balance, punishing pride wherever it grows.
features: Skill: Brought Low
Your smites against a creature with more hit points than you deal an extra 2d8 radiant damage.
Skill: Measured Vengeance
When an ally takes damage, your next smite against the attacker deals the same damage in addition.
Ultimate: The Scales Turn
Once per long rest, swap your current hit points with a creature you hit (Charisma save negates).
evolves: At level 21, if you reach Senior with Nemesis, your Scales Turn can target any creature you see.
cost: When you win a fight easily, you take 2d10 psychic damage as Nemesis balances you too.

requires: Paladin level 21, Oath of Vengeance subclass; Scavenging profession level 10
unlock: On the Ledger Spire's 23rd floor track a devil who stole a soul across three floors by its scent alone and drag it back.
secret: The soul must belong to someone you never met.
notice: [The debt is paid in blood. Hidden job: Hound of the Blood Debt.]
blurb: A Vengeance paladin who tracks sinners across realms by scent of the blood they spilled.
features: Skill: Blood Scent
You know the direction of any creature that has killed an innocent within the last week, within 1 mile.
Skill: Never Lose the Trail
Creatures you track cannot teleport or plane shift away from you without a Charisma save.
Ultimate: Debt Collected
Once per long rest, a creature you hit takes necrotic damage equal to the damage it dealt to innocents in the past day (max 100).
evolves: At level 31, after hunting a sinner into the Abyss, your Blood Scent works across realms.
cost: You must hunt any killer you catch scent of, even if it delays your other duties.

requires: Paladin level 5, Oath of the Ancients subclass
unlock: On floor 8 of the Milestone Spire a dead forest needs light; carry a lantern of fireflies through it until every tree buds.
secret: You must have planted at least 100 trees before entering.
notice: [The wood wakes. Hidden job change: Greenwood Lantern-Bearer.]
blurb: An Ancients paladin whose light makes green things grow and drives back the cold of dead places.
features: Skill: Firefly Lantern
Bright light surrounds you for 20 feet; allies there regain 1 hit point at the start of their turn if below half.
Skill: Budding Ground
Ground within your light becomes thick with growth; enemies there have their speed halved.
Ultimate: Spring Returns
Once per long rest, burst with green light: allies within 30 feet regain 4d8 hit points and enemies are restrained by vines (Strength save).
evolves: At level 15, after reviving a dead forest in the Mortal Realm, your lantern can heal blight in land.
cost: Iron weapons feel heavy in your hands; you take -1 to hit with them.

requires: Paladin level 11, Oath of the Ancients subclass; Normal contract with Cernunnos
unlock: In the Fogglass Spire a white stag runs through mist; follow it for a day and a night without harming it.
secret: You must sleep in the forest every night for a moon before the attempt.
notice: [The stag stops and bows its antlers. Hidden job: Horned Knight of Cernunnos.]
blurb: An Ancients paladin serving the horned god of wild things, crowned with antlers and followed by beasts.
features: Skill: Antler Crown
You grow antlers; a charge of 20 feet or more lets you add 2d8 piercing damage to your next hit.
Skill: Call of the Wild
As an action call 4 wolves or 1 bear to fight for you for 1 hour, once per long rest.
Ultimate: Stag King's Hunt
Once per long rest, you and allies within 30 feet move at double speed and have advantage on attacks against creatures that harmed beasts for 1 minute.
evolves: At level 21, if you reach Senior with Cernunnos, the white stag becomes your mount.
cost: You cannot eat meat from an animal you did not hunt yourself.

n: Last Hearth of the Old Grove
requires: Paladin level 21, Oath of the Ancients subclass; Harvesting profession level 10
unlock: On the Choir Spire's 22nd floor an old grove withers; harvest its last seeds and plant them on a floor of Hell before it dies.
secret: You must carry the seeds through Hell without using fire.
notice: [The grove is reborn in a strange place. Hidden job: Last Hearth of the Old Grove.]
blurb: An Ancients paladin who carries the seeds of the world's first forest, planting life in places that have none.
features: Skill: Seedbearer
Once per day, plant a seed that grows into a tree in 1 minute; creatures within 20 feet of it regain 2d6 hit points each turn.
Skill: Joy in the Dark
Your aura ends frightened and charmed conditions on allies at the start of their turns.
Ultimate: The Old Grove
Once per long rest, grow a grove in a 60 foot radius for 10 minutes: allies there are immune to necrotic damage and enemies are restrained (Strength save).
evolves: At level 31, after planting a grove in every realm you visit, you can grow one in the Void.
cost: You can never cut down a living tree.

requires: Paladin level 5, Oath of the Crown subclass
unlock: On floor 10 of the Milestone Spire escort a child king across a floor of bandits; he must not be hurt.
secret: You must have served a lord or king honestly for at least a year.
notice: [The king is safe. Hidden job change: Royal Shield of the Road.]
blurb: A Crown paladin who serves as a bodyguard, protecting the ruler with their life.
features: Skill: Ward the Throne
Choose one ally as your liege; when they are hit within 15 feet of you, use your reaction to take half the damage.
Skill: Royal Guard
Enemies attacking your liege have disadvantage while you are adjacent to it.
Ultimate: Die for the Crown
Once per long rest, when your liege would drop to 0, you swap places and take the hit; it deals no damage to you.
evolves: At level 15, after protecting a real king through a coup, you can choose two lieges.
cost: If your liege dies while you live, you lose this job until you find a new one.

requires: Paladin level 11, Oath of the Crown subclass; Law or Order Rune shard
unlock: In the Fogglass Spire a court of ghosts awaits judgment; judge 12 cases fairly before the fog swallows the courtroom.
secret: You must not take a bribe in any case, and some ghosts will try.
notice: [The court adjourns. The law stands. Hidden job: Magistrate of the Grey Law.]
blurb: A Crown paladin who judges like a magistrate, laying law on the battlefield.
features: Skill: Decree
As a bonus action declare a law (no running, no spells, no attacks on a chosen ally); creatures that break it take 3d8 radiant damage.
Skill: Sentence
Your smite can impose disadvantage on the target's next three attacks.
Ultimate: Law Absolute
Once per long rest for 1 minute, all creatures within 60 feet must obey up to three decrees or take 6d8 radiant damage each time.
evolves: At level 21, after judging a real case in a kingdom's court, your decrees can last a full day.
cost: You must obey your own decrees too.

requires: Paladin level 21, Oath of the Crown subclass; Senior contract with Utu
unlock: On the Choir Spire's 23rd floor a thief hides among the choir; find him by asking each singer one question.
secret: You must not use any spell to find the truth.
notice: [The sun sees all. You see it too. Hidden job: Utu's Sun-Judge.]
blurb: A Crown paladin serving the sun god of justice, seeing lies and sentencing the guilty.
features: Skill: Sun Sees All
You know when a creature lies within 60 feet and can see invisible creatures.
Skill: Verdict
When a creature you hit lied to you today, the hit deals an extra 4d10 radiant damage.
Ultimate: Final Sentence
Once per long rest, a creature you judge makes a Charisma save or is banished to the Choir Spire's courtroom for 1 hour.
evolves: At level 31, if you reach Apostle with Utu, your sentences hold even on gods' contractors.
cost: You can never lie, even to protect an ally.

requires: Paladin level 5, Oath of the Watchers subclass
unlock: On floor 7 of the Milestone Spire a portal opens every hour; stand guard and stop everything that comes through for a full day.
secret: You must have closed a real portal or rift in the Mortal Realm before entering.
notice: [The door is closed. You remain. Hidden job change: Threshold Sentinel.]
blurb: A Watchers paladin who guards doorways and thresholds where other realms leak in.
features: Skill: Door Watch
You sense portals and creatures from other realms within 120 feet.
Skill: Closed Door
Your smites on creatures from another realm stop them from teleporting for 1 minute.
Ultimate: Seal the Threshold
Once per long rest, close a portal or banish a creature not native to your realm (Charisma save).
evolves: At level 15, after guarding a rift for a whole season, you can seal portals permanently.
cost: You must investigate every portal you sense.

requires: Paladin level 11, Oath of the Watchers subclass; Navigation profession level 7
unlock: In the Fogglass Spire map every room on three shifting floors and find which one leads out of the Tower.
secret: You must make the map by hand and leave a copy on the floor.
notice: [You found the way out. Hidden job: Fogwatch Seer.]
blurb: A Watchers paladin who sees through illusions and maps the shifting places between realms.
features: Skill: Clear Sight
You see through illusions within 60 feet and cannot be lost.
Skill: Mapped Path
Allies within 30 feet cannot be teleported against their will.
Ultimate: Fogbreaker
Once per long rest, you clear all illusions and fog within 120 feet and reveal invisible creatures for 1 minute.
evolves: At level 21, after mapping a realm border, you can draw maps that lead to any Tower.
cost: You cannot rest in a place you have not mapped.

requires: Paladin level 21, Oath of the Watchers subclass; Gate or Plane Rune shard
unlock: In the Sunken Spire a gate leaks something from the Void; hold it shut for one hour against what pushes from the other side.
secret: You must not look through the gate, not even once.
notice: [The gate holds. The thing behind it waits. Hidden job: Heimward of the Last Gate.]
blurb: A Watchers paladin who holds the last gate between the realms and the Void.
features: Skill: Void Watch
You see creatures from the Void even when they are hidden by magic.
Skill: Gate Hold
Creatures from other realms cannot leave a 30 foot radius around you without your permission.
Ultimate: The Last Gate Closes
Once per long rest, a creature not native to your realm takes 12d10 force damage and is banished (Charisma save for half and no banish).
evolves: At level 31, after guarding the gate for a year, you can sense rifts across a whole realm.
cost: You must never sleep more than 4 hours at a time.

n: Hollow Knight of the Shattered Vow
requires: Paladin level 5, Oathbreaker subclass
unlock: On floor 9 of the Milestone Spire fight the ghost of your old oath and break it with your own sword.
secret: You must have broken your oath for a reason you still believe was right.
notice: [The vow shatters. Something else fills it. Hidden job change: Hollow Knight of the Shattered Vow.]
blurb: An Oathbreaker whose broken vow became hollow armor, empty but terrible.
features: Skill: Hollow Shell
Your armor gains +1 AC and you resist necrotic damage.
Skill: Echo of the Vow
Your smites deal necrotic damage and frighten the target (Wisdom save).
Ultimate: Shattered Vow
Once per long rest, explode with broken oath energy: 8d8 necrotic damage to creatures within 20 feet (Constitution save for half).
evolves: At level 15, after finding a new vow you choose yourself, your armor gains a new purpose.
cost: Holy places burn you; you take 1d10 radiant damage each hour inside them.

requires: Paladin level 11, Oathbreaker subclass; Demon or Devil Rune shard
unlock: On the Ledger Spire's 21st floor sign a devil's contract in your own blood and then betray it before it closes.
secret: You must break the contract without losing your soul.
notice: [You broke the unbreakable. Hell takes notice. Hidden job: Fallen Hound of the Pit.]
blurb: An Oathbreaker who serves no master, hunting both heaven and hell for its own ends.
features: Skill: Broken Leash
You cannot be charmed or bound by contracts unless you want to be.
Skill: Hellhound Aura
Fiends and undead within 30 feet obey simple commands from you (Charisma save).
Ultimate: Pit Fury
Once per long rest for 1 minute, your hits deal an extra 3d10 fire and necrotic damage and heal you for half.
evolves: At level 21, after betraying a devil lord, you can call hellhounds to your side.
cost: Devils hunt you and will try to bind you again.

requires: Paladin level 21, Oathbreaker subclass; Senior contract with Susanoo
unlock: In the Shuffled Spire defeat the champion of Amaterasu, the sister who cast the storm god out, using only storm and steel.
secret: You must have once held a contract with another god and broken it yourself.
notice: [The banished storm laughs. You are his now. Hidden job: Herald of the Scorned God.]
blurb: An Oathbreaker who took the side of a god who was also betrayed, serving vengeance on the heavens.
features: Skill: Scorned Blessing
You gain resistance to radiant damage and your smites deal an extra 2d10 necrotic damage.
Skill: Betrayer's Mark
Creatures you hit cannot benefit from divine magic for 1 minute.
Ultimate: Fall of the Heavens
Once per long rest, you call down a pillar of dark light: 12d10 necrotic damage in a 20 foot radius (Constitution save for half).
evolves: At level 31, if you reach Apostle with your new god, you can strip a holy creature's divinity.
cost: Every god but your patron sees you as an enemy.

requires: Paladin level 5, Oathbreaker Knight subclass
unlock: On floor 10 of the Milestone Spire switch sides mid-battle in a war between two armies and win for the side you joined.
secret: You must have betrayed a commander you once served loyally.
notice: [You changed colors. Victory follows. Hidden job change: Turncloak Marshal.]
blurb: An Oathbreaker Knight who uses betrayal as a tactic, striking hardest when trust is broken.
features: Skill: Turn the Cloak
Your first attack against a creature that considers you an ally is a critical hit.
Skill: Broken Trust
When an enemy betrays its allies or flees, you gain advantage on attacks against it.
Ultimate: Double Treachery
Once per long rest, for 1 minute your hits make a creature attack one of its allies as its reaction (Wisdom save).
evolves: At level 15, after betraying a kingdom for another, enemies' allies distrust them near you.
cost: No faction trusts you; prices are doubled and allies require proof of loyalty.

requires: Paladin level 11, Oathbreaker Knight subclass; Betrayal Rune shard
unlock: In the Shuffled Spire each floor you climb asks you to betray an ally; refuse once, and the floor asks again.
secret: You must eventually betray the floor itself, escaping without fulfilling its demand.
notice: [The Spire is betrayed. Hidden job: Ash-Crowned Betrayer.]
blurb: An Oathbreaker Knight whose power grows from the very act of betrayal, turning loyalty into a weapon.
features: Skill: Feed on Broken Oaths
When a creature within 60 feet breaks a promise or betrays an ally, you gain temporary hit points equal to your Paladin level.
Skill: Crown of Ash
Your aura makes enemies within 10 feet doubt their allies; they cannot benefit from help or flanking.
Ultimate: Grand Betrayal
Once per long rest, every creature within 60 feet makes a Wisdom save or attacks its nearest ally on its next turn.
evolves: At level 21, after betraying a god, you gain a fragment of the Betrayal Rune.
cost: You cannot accept help from allies; all healing on you from others is halved.

requires: Paladin level 21, Oathbreaker Knight subclass; Enchanting profession level 10
unlock: On the Ledger Spire's 23rd floor every broken oath is kept in a jar; steal yours back and bind it into your weapon.
secret: You must enchant the weapon yourself in the Spire, with no tools brought in.
notice: [Your broken oath is your blade. Hidden job: Grave-Herald of the Forsworn.]
blurb: An Oathbreaker Knight who carries their broken oath in their weapon, raising those who also broke faith.
features: Skill: Forsworn Blade
Your weapon deals an extra 2d8 necrotic damage and its hits stop healing for 1 round.
Skill: Call the Forsworn
Once per long rest, raise the spirits of three creatures who broke oaths; they fight for you for 1 minute.
Ultimate: Grave Oath
Once per long rest, a creature you strike makes a Charisma save or is bound by a broken oath: it takes 10d10 necrotic damage and cannot cast spells for 1 minute.
evolves: At level 31, after binding a god's broken oath, your blade can unbind divine contracts.
cost: Your blade whispers your oath's last words to you every night.

requires: Ranger level 5, Beast Lord subclass
unlock: On floor 8 of the Milestone Spire two rival wolf packs fight over one den; make both packs hunt together under you for one night.
secret: Neither pack's alpha may be killed, only humbled.
notice: [Two howls become one. Hidden job change: Packfather of the Twin Howl.]
blurb: A Beast Lord who stops leading two beasts and starts leading a pack, every bite timed to the last.
features: Skill: Twin Howl
When both your beasts hit the same creature in a round, it is knocked prone (Strength save).
Skill: Pack Grows
You can bond a third beast of CR 1/2 or lower; it acts on your initiative with your other beasts.
Ultimate: Hunt of the Whole Pack
Once per long rest, for 1 minute every beast you command makes an extra attack each turn and has advantage while an ally is adjacent to its target.
evolves: At level 15, after your pack brings down a Huge creature together, it can bond a fourth beast.
cost: Your beasts must eat first at every meal, before you or your allies.

requires: Ranger level 11, Beast Lord subclass; Riding or Migration Rune shard
unlock: In the Fogglass Spire a herd of mist elk stampedes in circles; ride at its head and lead it out of the Tower.
secret: You must never use a saddle or reins, only voice and hand.
notice: [The herd follows you home. Hidden job: Herd-King of the Mist Stampede.]
blurb: A Beast Lord who commands herds rather than packs, turning stampedes into a weapon.
features: Skill: Mist Herd
As an action, summon a stampede of spectral elk in a 60 foot line; creatures in it take 4d8 bludgeoning damage and fall prone (Dexterity save for half).
Skill: Ride the Herd
You and your beasts gain +20 feet of speed and can move through enemy spaces.
Ultimate: Endless Stampede
Once per long rest, the stampede lasts 1 minute, sweeping a 60 foot line at the start of each of your turns.
evolves: At level 21, after leading a real herd through a migration, your stampede can cross water and air.
cost: You cannot sleep indoors; walls make your beasts restless.

requires: Ranger level 21, Beast Lord subclass; Tailoring or Blacksmithing profession level 10; Senior contract with Lugh
unlock: On the Choir Spire's 22nd floor craft armor for both your beasts using only materials from creatures they killed in the Spire.
secret: The armor must be completed in one day, by your hand alone.
notice: [Two beasts gleam in your craft. Hidden job: Lugh's Beastwright.]
blurb: A Beast Lord who serves the god of craftsmanship, arming their beasts with gear as fine as any knight's.
features: Skill: Barding Mastery
Armor you craft for your beasts gives them +2 AC and adds the material's Potency to their damage.
Skill: Many Skills
Your beasts gain proficiency in all saving throws.
Ultimate: Masterwork Pack
Once per long rest, your beasts become Large for 1 minute, gain temporary hit points equal to your Ranger level times 3, and deal an extra 2d10 damage.
evolves: At level 31, if you reach Apostle with Lugh, your beasts' armor can carry enchantments of your choice.
cost: Your gear needs constant care; skipping maintenance for a day drops the beasts' AC bonus.

requires: Ranger level 5, Beast Master subclass
unlock: On floor 6 of the Milestone Spire your companion is lost in a maze; find it by calling only its name.
secret: Your companion must have been with you for at least one year.
notice: [You found each other. Hidden job change: Heartbound Keeper.]
blurb: A Beast Master whose bond is so deep they share wounds and strength with their companion.
features: Skill: Shared Heart
When your companion takes damage, you can take half of it instead, and vice versa.
Skill: Beast's Eyes
You can see and hear through your companion's senses at will.
Ultimate: One Heart
Once per long rest, you and your companion share a hit point pool equal to both of your maximums for 1 minute and both gain an extra attack.
evolves: At level 15, after your companion saves your life, it gains your proficiency in one skill.
cost: If your companion dies, you lose all levels of this job until you bond with a new one for a year.

requires: Ranger level 11, Beast Master subclass; Spirit or Pet Rune shard
unlock: In the Fogglass Spire your companion's spirit leaves its body; follow it through mist and bring it back.
secret: You must let it go if it asks to stay, and it never asks if your bond is true.
notice: [It returned, but changed. Hidden job: Spirit-Kin of the Fog Beast.]
blurb: A Beast Master whose companion is half spirit, able to slip into the mist and through walls.
features: Skill: Mist Body
Your companion can become incorporeal for 1 round as a bonus action, passing through creatures and objects.
Skill: Spirit Bite
Your companion's attacks deal force damage and ignore resistance.
Ultimate: Ghost Hunt
Once per long rest, your companion splits into three spirit copies for 1 minute, each attacking independently.
evolves: At level 21, after your companion dies and returns as a spirit, it can no longer die by physical damage.
cost: Your companion vanishes into mist whenever it is wounded below half, returning after a short rest.

requires: Ranger level 21, Beast Master subclass; Senior contract with Artemis
unlock: On the Choir Spire's 21st floor hunt a silver deer with only your companion and your bow, sparing it at the last moment.
secret: You must never have hunted for sport.
notice: [The goddess of the hunt approves. Hidden job: Artemis's Hound-Mother.]
blurb: A Beast Master serving the goddess of the hunt, their companion blessed with silver moonlight.
features: Skill: Silver Hound
Your companion's attacks deal an extra 2d8 radiant damage and it sees through magical darkness.
Skill: Moonlit Hunt
You and your companion are invisible in moonlight while not attacking.
Ultimate: Hunt of the Goddess
Once per long rest, summon a pack of 6 silver hounds that hunt one target for 1 minute, each attacking with advantage.
evolves: At level 31, if you reach Apostle with Artemis, your companion can transform into a silver stag.
cost: You can never kill a pregnant beast or a young animal.

requires: Ranger level 5, Drakewarden subclass
unlock: On floor 10 of the Milestone Spire ride your drake across a chasm while wind spirits try to throw you off.
secret: Your drake must have hatched from an egg you kept warm yourself.
notice: [First flight complete. Hidden job change: Drake-Rider of the First Wing.]
blurb: A Drakewarden who rides their drake into battle long before it should be big enough to carry them.
features: Skill: Early Wings
Your drake can carry you as a mount even while Medium, flying at 30 feet.
Skill: Diving Strike
When your drake dives at least 20 feet before attacking, you and it each deal an extra 2d6 damage.
Ultimate: Sky Charge
Once per long rest, you and your drake charge in a 60 foot line; every creature in it takes 6d8 damage of your drake's breath type (Dexterity save for half).
evolves: At level 15, after flying above a Tower's peak, your drake grows to Large early.
cost: You cannot ride any other creature; it refuses you.

requires: Ranger level 11, Drakewarden subclass; Harvesting profession level 7
unlock: On the Ledger Spire's 21st floor steal a clutch of eggs from a fire wyrm and keep them warm in Hell's cold rooms.
secret: All the eggs must hatch, and you must return one to the wyrm.
notice: [The eggs hatch in your arms. Hidden job: Ember-Egg Brooder.]
blurb: A Drakewarden who raises many small drakes instead of one, a swarm of hatchlings around them.
features: Skill: Clutch
You gain three Tiny drake hatchlings; each can bite for 1d6 damage of your drake's breath type.
Skill: Brood Breath
Your hatchlings breathe together as an action, a 30 foot cone dealing 6d6 damage (Dexterity save for half).
Ultimate: Mother of Drakes
Once per long rest, all your hatchlings grow to Medium for 1 minute and fight like your main drake.
evolves: At level 21, after raising a hatchling to adulthood, it can become a second drake companion.
cost: Your hatchlings must eat rare meat every day or wander off.

requires: Ranger level 21, Drakewarden subclass; Dragon Rune shard
unlock: In the Shuffled Spire a dragon's skeleton lies on a floor that changes realm each hour; read its scales to learn its last words.
secret: You must have let your drake drink from a stream in each of three realms.
notice: [The dragon's last words become yours. Hidden job: Wyrm-Scale Oracle.]
blurb: A Drakewarden whose drake carries a shard of the Dragon Rune, growing into something closer to a true wyrm.
features: Skill: Rune-Blooded Drake
Your drake becomes Huge, gains 50 extra hit points and a flying speed of 80 feet.
Skill: Shifting Breath
Your drake can change its breath type each turn.
Ultimate: Wyrm's Roar
Once per long rest, your drake roars: creatures within 120 feet are frightened (Wisdom save) and take 12d10 damage of its breath type (Dexterity save for half).
evolves: At level 31, after your drake fights a true dragon, it can learn one dragon's spell.
cost: Dragons see your drake as a rival and attack it on sight.

requires: Ranger level 5, Fey Wanderer subclass
unlock: On floor 7 of the Milestone Spire step into a fairy ring and dance until dawn without tiring or losing your name.
secret: You must have been invited to a fey revel and turned it down politely.
notice: [You danced out. Hidden job change: Mushroom-Ring Dancer.]
blurb: A Fey Wanderer who dances through battle, leaving rings of mushrooms that trap the unwary.
features: Skill: Ring Step
After you move at least 10 feet, leave a 5 foot mushroom ring; a creature entering it is charmed until the end of its turn (Wisdom save).
Skill: Dancer's Feet
You can't be grappled or restrained, and you move at double speed while dancing.
Ultimate: Revel Without End
Once per long rest, a 30 foot fairy ring traps enemies in a dance for 1 minute (Wisdom save each turn).
evolves: At level 15, after leading a fey revel, your rings can carry you between forests.
cost: You must dance at least an hour each day or lose this job's features.

n: Masked Guest of the Thorn Court
requires: Ranger level 11, Fey Wanderer subclass; Mask or Charm Rune shard
unlock: In the Fogglass Spire a fey court holds a masked ball; dance with the queen and leave without accepting a gift.
secret: You must never reveal your true name to anyone at the ball.
notice: [The court remembers you. Hidden job: Masked Guest of the Thorn Court.]
blurb: A Fey Wanderer who walks the fey courts in masks, charming enemies and stealing their secrets.
features: Skill: Court Mask
While masked, you have advantage on Charisma checks and creatures can't recognize you.
Skill: Guest's Charm
When a creature attacks you, it makes a Wisdom save or the attack targets another creature of your choice.
Ultimate: Thorn Waltz
Once per long rest, every creature within 30 feet makes a Wisdom save or is charmed and dances for 1 minute.
evolves: At level 21, after attending three fey courts, you can call the court's knights to your aid.
cost: Fey will collect any debt you owe them, in strange ways.

requires: Ranger level 21, Fey Wanderer subclass; Senior contract with Persephone
unlock: On the Choir Spire's 22nd floor carry spring into a winter garden; every flower must bloom.
secret: You must have spent a winter in darkness, underground.
notice: [Spring has come. Hidden job: Persephone's Season-Walker.]
blurb: A Fey Wanderer serving the queen of spring, walking between the seasons and carrying each one with them.
features: Skill: Seasonal Step
At the start of each of your turns, choose a season: spring heals 2d8, summer adds 2d8 fire to hits, autumn slows enemies, winter adds 2d8 cold to hits.
Skill: Two Halves
You can move between the material and fey realms as a bonus action once per short rest.
Ultimate: Wheel of Seasons
Once per long rest for 1 minute, all four season effects apply at once.
evolves: At level 31, if you reach Apostle with Persephone, you can change the season of a whole region.
cost: You must spend one month a year underground.

requires: Ranger level 5, Gloom Stalker subclass
unlock: On floor 9 of the Milestone Spire extinguish every torch while the floor's creatures hunt you, then hunt them back.
secret: You must have spent a full week without any light.
notice: [Darkness is your friend. Hidden job change: Lampless Hunter.]
blurb: A Gloom Stalker who stops hiding in darkness and becomes the darkness itself.
features: Skill: Lampless
You can see in magical darkness, and light sources you touch go out.
Skill: Shadow Ambush
When you attack from darkness, you deal an extra 2d8 damage.
Ultimate: Lightless World
Once per long rest, you create magical darkness in a 60 foot radius for 1 minute; you have advantage on all attacks within it.
evolves: At level 15, after hunting in the Unlit Spire's darkness, your eyes see through any light.
cost: Bright light blinds you for 1 round when you enter it.

requires: Ranger level 11, Gloom Stalker subclass; Engineering profession level 7
unlock: In the Fogglass Spire build traps from salvaged parts and catch every creature on one floor without striking a single blow.
secret: None of your traps may kill, only hold.
notice: [The fog is full of your traps. Hidden job: Fog-Trap Warden.]
blurb: A Gloom Stalker who hunts with traps hidden in mist and shadow, letting prey walk into their death.
features: Skill: Mist Trap
Set a trap as a bonus action; creatures that step on it are restrained and take 3d8 piercing damage (Dexterity save).
Skill: Trap Network
You can have up to five traps active, and know when one is sprung.
Ultimate: Killing Field
Once per long rest, every trap you have springs at once and deals an extra 6d8 damage.
evolves: At level 21, after trapping a creature from a higher realm, your traps work in any realm.
cost: Your traps cost 10 gold in materials each.

requires: Ranger level 21, Gloom Stalker subclass; Senior contract with Tsukuyomi
unlock: In the Sunken Spire hunt on a floor where the moon has fallen; carry its light out without using it.
secret: You must have fought in the dark of the new moon for a year.
notice: [The moon goes dark. You do not. Hidden job: Tsukuyomi's Moonless Blade.]
blurb: A Gloom Stalker serving the moon god, hunting best when the moon is hidden.
features: Skill: Dark Moon
On nights without a moon, your attacks are critical on 18-20.
Skill: Eclipse Strike
Your first attack in combat deals an extra 6d8 necrotic damage.
Ultimate: Night Without End
Once per long rest, for 1 minute it is moonless night in a 120 foot radius; enemies there are blinded and you have advantage on every attack.
evolves: At level 31, if you reach Apostle with Tsukuyomi, you can call a moonless night anywhere.
cost: You cannot see the sun without taking 2d10 radiant damage.

requires: Ranger level 5, Horizon Walker subclass
unlock: On floor 8 of the Milestone Spire small rifts tear open each round; sew them shut with thread you made yourself.
secret: You must have walked into a rift in the Mortal Realm and come back.
notice: [The tears are sewn. Hidden job change: Rift-Stitcher.]
blurb: A Horizon Walker who closes the tears between realms with needle and thread.
features: Skill: Rift Thread
As an action, close a rift or portal within 30 feet or stop a creature from teleporting (Charisma save).
Skill: Stitch Strike
When you hit a creature, it cannot teleport for 1 minute.
Ultimate: Sew the Sky Shut
Once per long rest, you close every portal within 120 feet and banish creatures from other realms in that area (Charisma save).
evolves: At level 15, after stitching a large rift, you can sew portals open as well.
cost: You must carry 100 feet of thread you made yourself.

requires: Ranger level 11, Horizon Walker subclass; Navigation profession level 7
unlock: In the Fogglass Spire deliver a letter to each of 10 rooms that move every minute.
secret: You must not open or read a single letter.
notice: [All letters delivered. Hidden job: Fog-Step Courier.]
blurb: A Horizon Walker who carries messages between realms, slipping through fog to any address.
features: Skill: Fog Step
As a bonus action, teleport 30 feet into any fog, shadow or mist.
Skill: Always Arrive
You always know the way to any location you have been told about.
Ultimate: Courier's Leap
Once per long rest, you and up to five allies teleport to any place you have mapped.
evolves: At level 21, after delivering a letter to a god, you can carry messages across realms.
cost: You must deliver any letter given to you, even to enemies.

requires: Ranger level 21, Horizon Walker subclass; Senior contract with Hermes
unlock: On the Choir Spire's 21st floor race Hermes's herald across seven doors to seven realms and win.
secret: You must have crossed into at least four realms already.
notice: [The messenger of the gods laughs and gives you his sandals. Hidden job: Hermes's Threshold-Runner.]
blurb: A Horizon Walker serving the messenger god, running between realms faster than any other.
features: Skill: Winged Sandals
You gain a flying speed of 60 feet and can't be slowed.
Skill: Threshold Dash
Once per turn, you can step through a portal you create to any spot within 120 feet.
Ultimate: Run of the Gods
Once per long rest, you and up to six allies can travel to any realm you have visited in one minute.
evolves: At level 31, if you reach Apostle with Hermes, you can carry messages to any god.
cost: You must never refuse a race.

requires: Ranger level 5, Hunter subclass
unlock: On floor 10 of the Milestone Spire hit 10 moving targets in a row from 300 feet.
secret: You must have hunted with the same bow for five years.
notice: [Ten for ten. Hidden job change: Sure-Arrow of the Long Field.]
blurb: A Hunter who takes the long shot every time and rarely misses.
features: Skill: Long Shot
Your ranged attacks ignore disadvantage at long range.
Skill: Steady Aim
If you don't move on your turn, your ranged attacks deal an extra 2d6 damage.
Ultimate: Arrow Through All
Once per long rest, a single arrow pierces every creature in a 300 foot line, dealing double damage.
evolves: At level 15, after hitting a target a mile away, your range doubles.
cost: You must make your own arrows.

requires: Ranger level 11, Hunter subclass; Scavenging profession level 7
unlock: In the Fogglass Spire hunt a beast whose hide holds a map; skin it and follow the map to the stairs.
secret: You must use every part of the beast you kill.
notice: [The hide shows the way. Hidden job: Trophy-Taker of the Butcher's Tent.]
blurb: A Hunter who takes trophies from prey and wears their strengths as their own.
features: Skill: Trophy
After killing a creature, take a trophy; you gain one of its resistances or senses until your next long rest.
Skill: Prey Knowledge
You have advantage on attacks against creatures of a type you have taken a trophy from.
Ultimate: Hall of Trophies
Once per long rest, gain every trophy benefit you have collected at once for 1 minute.
evolves: At level 21, after taking a trophy from a creature of a higher realm, you can keep two trophies at a time.
cost: Your trophies decay after a month, and you must hunt again.

requires: Ranger level 21, Hunter subclass; Senior contract with Odin
unlock: In the Shuffled Spire hunt two wolves that change floors each hour and tame them both.
secret: You must not kill the wolves, only exhaust them.
notice: [Two wolves follow you now. Hidden job: Odin's Wolf-Rider.]
blurb: A Hunter serving the Allfather, riding into battle with two great wolves at their side.
features: Skill: Two Wolves
You gain two dire wolves; each attacks on your turn.
Skill: Ravens Watch
You see what two spectral ravens see within 1 mile.
Ultimate: Hunt of the Allfather
Once per long rest, every creature you choose within 120 feet becomes your prey for 1 minute; your attacks and your wolves' attacks deal an extra 4d10 damage to them.
evolves: At level 31, if you reach Apostle with Odin, your wolves grow to Huge.
cost: Odin asks a question each night; you must answer truthfully.

requires: Ranger level 5, Monster Slayer subclass
unlock: On floor 7 of the Milestone Spire a beast changes shape each round; find its true form and kill it before it hides again.
secret: You must have killed at least 20 monsters before entering.
notice: [True form revealed. Hidden job change: Hide-Hunter of the Grey Road.]
blurb: A Monster Slayer who reads the true form of a monster no matter how well it hides.
features: Skill: True Form
You see through shape-changers and illusions within 30 feet.
Skill: Weak Spot
Your first hit each turn against a monster deals an extra 2d6 damage.
Ultimate: Monster's End
Once per long rest, your attack against a monster is a critical hit and it can't change shape for a day.
evolves: At level 15, after slaying a shapechanger in its true form, you can force it to stay in that form.
cost: Monsters can smell you from a mile away.

requires: Ranger level 11, Monster Slayer subclass; Alchemy profession level 7
unlock: In the Fogglass Spire a vampire hides in a mirror maze; brew a poison from its own blood and kill it with it.
secret: You must gather the blood yourself, during the hunt.
notice: [The poison is perfect. Hidden job: Brew-Hunter of the Silver Vial.]
blurb: A Monster Slayer who brews poisons tailored to each monster's weakness.
features: Skill: Silver Vial
You can coat a weapon with a poison that deals an extra 3d8 damage of a type the target is vulnerable to.
Skill: Blood Tells
Tasting a creature's blood tells you all its weaknesses and resistances.
Ultimate: Bane Brew
Once per long rest, you create a poison that kills any monster of one type below 50 hit points instantly (Constitution save).
evolves: At level 21, after brewing a poison for a god's beast, you can brew for creatures from any realm.
cost: Your poisons have a 1 in 20 chance of harming you instead.

requires: Ranger level 21, Monster Slayer subclass; Senior contract with Morrigan
unlock: On the Ledger Spire's 23rd floor hunt a monster whose death is promised to Morrigan; kill it at the exact moment she names.
secret: You must not be early or late by a second.
notice: [The goddess of fate takes her due. Hidden job: Morrigan's Monster-Bane.]
blurb: A Monster Slayer serving the goddess of fate, killing monsters at the exact moment fate decrees.
features: Skill: Fated Death
You know when a creature within 60 feet will die within the next round.
Skill: Crow's Mark
Creatures you mark cannot regain hit points while the mark lasts.
Ultimate: Fate's Call
Once per long rest, choose a monster: it dies in 3 rounds unless it succeeds on three Constitution saves.
evolves: At level 31, if you reach Apostle with Morrigan, you can see the death of any creature you look at.
cost: You must kill the monsters fate decrees.

requires: Ranger level 5, Moon Hunter subclass
unlock: On floor 9 of the Milestone Spire track a wolf through a forest under a full moon and find its human form at dawn.
secret: You must have slain at least one shapechanger before entering.
notice: [The trail ends at dawn. Hidden job change: Silver-Fang Tracker.]
blurb: A Moon Hunter who tracks shapechangers by their scent, which never changes with their form.
features: Skill: Unchanging Scent
You can track any creature you have smelled, even if it changes shape.
Skill: Silver Fang
Your weapons count as silvered and deal an extra 1d8 damage to shapechangers.
Ultimate: Moon's Revealing
Once per long rest, all shapechangers within 120 feet are forced into their true form.
evolves: At level 15, after tracking a shapechanger to its lair, you can track creatures across realms.
cost: You become restless during full moons and cannot rest.

requires: Ranger level 11, Moon Hunter subclass; Normal contract with Selene
unlock: On the Choir Spire's 21st floor shoot an arrow at the moon so it lands back in your hands.
secret: You must make the arrow from moon-silvered wood.
notice: [The moon returns your arrow. Hidden job: Selene's Night-Archer.]
blurb: A Moon Hunter serving the goddess of the moon, shooting arrows of moonlight.
features: Skill: Moon Arrows
Your arrows deal radiant damage and shed dim light.
Skill: Moonlit Aim
In moonlight, your ranged attacks have advantage.
Ultimate: Full Moon Volley
Once per long rest, you rain moonlit arrows on a 30 foot radius: 8d8 radiant damage (Dexterity save for half).
evolves: At level 21, if you reach Senior with Selene, your Moon Arrows work even in daylight.
cost: You must hunt one night every month under the moon.

requires: Ranger level 21, Moon Hunter subclass; Shape-shifter Rune shard
unlock: In the Sunken Spire accept a werewolf's bite and fight off the curse for three nights without losing control.
secret: You must have no other curses on you.
notice: [You kept your mind. Hidden job: Wolf-Blood Hunter.]
blurb: A Moon Hunter who took the curse they hunt, becoming a wolf who hunts wolves.
features: Skill: Controlled Change
You can change into a wolf-like hybrid form as a bonus action; your hits deal an extra 2d8 damage.
Skill: Pack Leader
Shapechangers have disadvantage on saves against your effects.
Ultimate: Moon's Wrath
Once per long rest, under the moon, you grow to Large for 1 minute and make three attacks each turn.
evolves: At level 31, after defeating a pack leader, you can cure lycanthropy with your bite.
cost: Under the full moon, you must change and fight anything near you.

requires: Ranger level 5, Swarmkeeper subclass
unlock: On floor 6 of the Milestone Spire tend a dying hive until it thrives again.
secret: You must keep bees for at least a year before entering.
notice: [The hive sings. Hidden job change: Hive-Heart Keeper.]
blurb: A Swarmkeeper whose swarm grows from a hive within their own chest.
features: Skill: Hive Heart
Your swarm can sting for an extra 1d6 poison damage.
Skill: Honeyed Wounds
Your swarm can heal an ally for 2d6 hit points as a bonus action.
Ultimate: Great Swarm
Once per long rest, your swarm fills a 30 foot radius; enemies take 6d6 poison damage each turn (Constitution save for half).
evolves: At level 15, after protecting a hive from destruction, your swarm can carry you.
cost: You cannot wear heavy armor; your swarm needs to move freely.

requires: Ranger level 11, Swarmkeeper subclass; Illusion Rune shard
unlock: In the Fogglass Spire gather moths that eat mist and lead them to a mirror floor.
secret: You must not crush a single moth.
notice: [The moths are yours. Hidden job: Mist-Moth Shepherd.]
blurb: A Swarmkeeper whose swarm is made of moths that eat illusions and light.
features: Skill: Moth Cloud
Your swarm eats light; creatures within 10 feet of it are blinded (Constitution save).
Skill: Eat Illusions
Your swarm devours illusions and magical darkness within 30 feet.
Ultimate: Moth Storm
Once per long rest, your swarm devours spells in a 60 foot radius, ending all magical effects there.
evolves: At level 21, after your moths eat a god's illusion, they can eat memories.
cost: Your moths need light to feed on every day.

requires: Ranger level 21, Swarmkeeper subclass; Senior contract with Brigid
unlock: On the Choir Spire's 23rd floor heal a whole ward of sick angels using honey from your swarm.
secret: You must not use any other medicine.
notice: [The goddess of healing blesses your bees. Hidden job: Brigid's Bee-Saint.]
blurb: A Swarmkeeper serving the goddess of healing, their bees making honey that cures wounds and illness.
features: Skill: Holy Honey
Your bees produce honey that heals 4d8 hit points and cures diseases.
Skill: Swarm of Saints
Your swarm grants allies within 30 feet resistance to poison and necrotic damage.
Ultimate: Hive of Healing
Once per long rest, your swarm heals all allies within 60 feet for 10d8 hit points.
evolves: At level 31, if you reach Apostle with Brigid, your honey can bring back the dead within 1 minute.
cost: Your bees must be tended every day.

requires: Ranger level 5, Thornwalker subclass
unlock: On floor 8 of the Milestone Spire walk through a briar maze barefoot without bleeding.
secret: You must have slept in briars at least once.
notice: [The thorns part for you. Hidden job change: Briar-Coat Wanderer.]
blurb: A Thornwalker who wears thorns as armor, wounding anyone who touches them.
features: Skill: Briar Coat
Creatures that hit you with a melee attack take 1d6 piercing damage.
Skill: Thorn Grip
Creatures grappling you take 2d6 piercing damage each turn.
Ultimate: Briar Fortress
