Once per long rest, thorns surround you in a 15 foot radius for 1 minute; creatures that enter take 4d8 piercing damage.
evolves: At level 15, after surviving a thorny wild hunt, your coat grows +1 AC.
cost: You cannot hug or be touched without hurting those you love.

requires: Ranger level 11, Thornwalker subclass; Bleed or Blossom Rune shard
unlock: On the Ledger Spire's 21st floor grow a rose in Hell's dust by watering it with your own blood.
secret: The rose must bloom before you leave the floor.
notice: [A rose blooms in Hell. Hidden job: Rose-Blood Warden.]
blurb: A Thornwalker whose thorns bloom red with blood, feeding on the wounds they cause.
features: Skill: Blood Blossom
When you deal damage with thorns, you regain hit points equal to half the damage.
Skill: Crimson Thicket
You can create a thicket of blood-thorns in a 20 foot radius; enemies there bleed for 2d6 damage each turn.
Ultimate: Rose of Hell
Once per long rest, a giant rose blooms around a creature: 10d10 piercing damage and restrained (Strength save for half).
evolves: At level 21, after watering a rose with a devil's blood, your thorns burn fiends.
cost: You must water your rose every day with your blood.

n: Carving Hand of the Thorn Throne
requires: Ranger level 21, Thornwalker subclass; Carving profession level 10
unlock: In the Shuffled Spire carve a throne from a living thorn tree while its branches attack you.
secret: You must not cut a single branch that does not need to be cut.
notice: [The throne is finished. Hidden job: Carving Hand of the Thorn Throne.]
blurb: A Thornwalker who shapes thorns like a carver, building weapons and walls from living wood.
features: Skill: Thorn Weapons
You can grow a thorn weapon in your hand that deals 2d10 piercing damage and counts as magical.
Skill: Living Walls
Grow a wall of thorns 60 feet long; it has 100 hit points and deals 4d8 to creatures that touch it.
Ultimate: Throne of Thorns
Once per long rest, grow a thorn throne; while seated, you can control all plants within 300 feet for 1 minute.
evolves: At level 31, after carving a throne for a god, your thorns can grow in the Void.
cost: You must carve a gift for a stranger every month.

requires: Ranger level 5, Void Stalker subclass
unlock: On floor 10 of the Milestone Spire find the one creature that should not be there, a thing from the Void hidden among the others.
secret: You must have seen something from the Void and not gone mad.
notice: [You see what is not there. Hidden job change: Null-Eye Scout.]
blurb: A Void Stalker whose eyes see the empty places where Void creatures hide.
features: Skill: Null Sight
You see creatures from the Void even when invisible.
Skill: Hole in the World
Your attacks deal an extra 2d6 force damage to creatures from the Void.
Ultimate: Erase
Once per long rest, a Void creature you hit makes a Charisma save or is erased from existence.
evolves: At level 15, after hunting a Void creature into the Hollow Spire, your sight works across realms.
cost: You see things in corners that are not there and must make a Wisdom save each night to sleep.

requires: Ranger level 11, Void Stalker subclass; Reflection or Mirror Realm Rune shard
unlock: In the Fogglass Spire hunt something that lives only in mirrors and drag it out.
secret: You must not break a single mirror.
notice: [The reflection is yours now. Hidden job: Fog-Mirror Watcher.]
blurb: A Void Stalker who hunts things that hide in reflections and the empty spaces behind them.
features: Skill: Reflection Hunt
You can attack creatures in mirrors or reflections within 30 feet.
Skill: Mirror Step
Teleport between reflective surfaces within 120 feet as a bonus action.
Ultimate: Shatter the Mirror
Once per long rest, every creature hiding in reflections within 300 feet is forced out and takes 8d10 force damage.
evolves: At level 21, after hunting in the Mirror Realm, you can step into it.
cost: Your reflection sometimes moves on its own.

requires: Ranger level 21, Void Stalker subclass; Enchanting profession level 10
unlock: In the Sunken Spire craft a lantern that shows Void creatures and use it to hunt through three dark floors.
secret: You must make the lantern from the essence of a Void creature you killed.
notice: [The lantern burns empty light. Hidden job: Hollow-Lantern Hunter.]
blurb: A Void Stalker who hunts with an enchanted lantern that reveals the empty things.
features: Skill: Hollow Lantern
Your lantern reveals Void creatures within 120 feet and stops them from teleporting.
Skill: Empty Light
Void creatures in your lantern's light take 2d10 force damage at the start of their turns.
Ultimate: Lantern of the End
Once per long rest, your lantern flares: Void creatures within 120 feet take 15d10 force damage (Constitution save for half).
evolves: At level 31, after hunting in the Void, your lantern can lead you anywhere in it.
cost: Your lantern needs Void essence to burn each week.

requires: Rogue level 5, Arcane Trickster subclass
unlock: On floor 7 of the Milestone Spire a goblin shaman guards a spellbook; steal one spell from it without him noticing.
secret: You must have picked at least 100 pockets with your mage hand.
notice: [A spell is missing. No one saw. Hidden job change: Sleight-of-Spell Cutpurse.]
blurb: An Arcane Trickster who picks spells out of the air the way others pick pockets.
features: Skill: Lift a Charm
When a creature within 30 feet casts a spell of 1st level, you can use your reaction to steal it; it fails and you can cast it once within 1 hour.
Skill: Hidden Hands
Your mage hand is invisible and can make Sleight of Hand checks at 60 feet.
Ultimate: Grand Lift
Once per long rest, steal a spell of 5th level or lower as it is cast.
evolves: At level 15, after stealing a spell from a god's contractor, you can store two stolen spells.
cost: Spellcasters can sense you within 30 feet.

requires: Rogue level 11, Arcane Trickster subclass; Illusion or Gamble Rune shard
unlock: In the Shuffled Spire play a card game against the floor's master and win with cards that do not exist.
secret: You must not be caught cheating, though everyone knows you are.
notice: [The game is yours. Hidden job: Ghost-Card Illusionist.]
blurb: An Arcane Trickster whose illusions are dealt like cards, each one a trick waiting to be played.
features: Skill: Deal a Card
As a bonus action, create an illusion double of yourself; attacks against you have a 50 percent chance to hit it instead.
Skill: Card Swap
Swap places with any illusion you created as a bonus action.
Ultimate: Full House
Once per long rest, create five illusion doubles that each make a sneak attack on their own turn for 1 minute.
evolves: At level 21, after dealing a hand to a god, your illusions become real for a round.
cost: You must play a game of chance with anyone who challenges you.

requires: Rogue level 21, Arcane Trickster subclass; Senior contract with Hecate
unlock: On the Ledger Spire's 22nd floor steal a key from a three-headed watchdog at a crossroads without waking it.
secret: You must offer the goddess a stolen secret as payment.
notice: [The goddess of magic takes your offering. Hidden job: Hecate's Crossroads Thief.]
blurb: An Arcane Trickster serving the goddess of crossroads and magic, stealing at the meeting of paths.
features: Skill: Crossroads Step
Once per turn, you can teleport to any spot where two paths cross within 120 feet.
Skill: Witch's Lock
Locks, wards and seals open for you as if you held the key.
Ultimate: Three Paths
Once per long rest, split into three copies for 1 minute, each with your full abilities.
evolves: At level 31, if you reach Apostle with Hecate, you can steal spells from gods.
cost: You must leave an offering at every crossroads you pass.

requires: Rogue level 5, Assassin subclass
unlock: On floor 9 of the Milestone Spire deliver a sealed letter to the floor's boss; the letter's message is his death.
secret: You must have accepted a contract and fulfilled it within a week.
notice: [The message is delivered. Hidden job change: Last-Breath Courier.]
blurb: An Assassin who walks into the target's room as an invited guest and leaves them dead.
features: Skill: Invited Guest
Creatures that let you into a room have disadvantage on Insight checks against you.
Skill: Message Delivered
Your sneak attack against a creature you have spoken with today deals an extra 2d6 damage.
Ultimate: Final Letter
Once per long rest, a creature you hit makes a Constitution save or drops to 0 hit points if it is below half.
evolves: At level 15, after killing a king's general in his own tent, you can disguise yourself as any messenger.
cost: You must never deliver a message falsely.

requires: Rogue level 11, Assassin subclass; Alchemy profession level 7
unlock: In the Fogglass Spire a dinner party of ghosts waits; poison one glass so only the guilty one drinks it.
secret: You must not taste any wine yourself.
notice: [The guilty one drank. Hidden job: Poison-Glass Sommelier.]
blurb: An Assassin who brews poisons into wine and food, killing at the dinner table.
features: Skill: Taste of Death
You can poison food or drink so it deals 4d10 poison damage to whoever consumes it (Constitution save for half).
Skill: Fine Palate
You know if any food or drink is poisoned by smell.
Ultimate: Last Supper
Once per long rest, a poison you serve forces a creature to make a Constitution save or die if below 50 hit points.
evolves: At level 21, after poisoning a god's servant, your poisons can affect creatures immune to poison.
cost: You must eat only food you have prepared yourself.

requires: Rogue level 21, Assassin subclass; Senior contract with Shiva
unlock: In the Shuffled Spire dance the dance of endings on a floor that is crumbling, and kill the floor's master on the last step.
secret: You must not stop dancing for one hour.
notice: [The transformer god watches. Hidden job: Shiva's Final Dance.]
blurb: An Assassin serving the transformer and destroyer god, killing as part of the cosmic dance of endings.
features: Skill: Dance of Endings
Each time you move at least 10 feet, your next attack deals an extra 2d8 damage.
Skill: Third Eye
You can see all creatures within 60 feet, even invisible or hidden ones.
Ultimate: Cosmic End
Once per long rest, every creature you hit for 1 minute must make a Constitution save or drop to 0 hit points if below half.
evolves: At level 31, if you reach Apostle with Shiva, your dance can destroy buildings.
cost: You must dance at least an hour every day.

requires: Rogue level 5, Blood Dancer subclass
unlock: On floor 8 of the Milestone Spire dance across a floor of blades, leaving a trail of your blood that forms a pattern.
secret: You must have bled at least 100 hit points' worth in fights.
notice: [The ribbon is red. Hidden job change: Red Ribbon Dancer.]
blurb: A Blood Dancer whose blood flows like ribbons, whipping enemies as they spin.
features: Skill: Blood Ribbon
Spend 5 hit points to make your blood a 10 foot whip; it deals 1d8 slashing damage.
Skill: Spinning Cut
Your ribbon can hit two creatures in one attack.
Ultimate: Crimson Spiral
Once per long rest, spin a 20 foot radius of blood; every creature takes 6d8 slashing damage (Dexterity save for half).
evolves: At level 15, after dancing in a god's temple, your ribbons are also radiant.
cost: Each use of your ribbon costs blood that cannot be healed by magic until you rest.

requires: Rogue level 11, Blood Dancer subclass; Blood or Lifesteal Rune shard
unlock: On the Ledger Spire's 21st floor pay a debt in blood: give 50 hit points and win your blood back from the devil.
secret: You must not use healing magic during the trial.
notice: [Blood paid back with interest. Hidden job: Thirst-Blade of the Ledger.]
blurb: A Blood Dancer who drinks blood back from enemies, repaying every wound they take.
features: Skill: Thirst
Your sneak attack heals you for half the damage dealt.
Skill: Blood Debt
Creatures that damage you bleed for 1d10 damage on their next turn.
Ultimate: Pay in Full
Once per long rest, a creature you hit loses hit points equal to the total damage you have taken this fight.
evolves: At level 21, after paying back a devil's debt, your blood is immune to curses.
cost: You must drink blood every week or lose your Thirst.

requires: Rogue level 21, Blood Dancer subclass; Cooking profession level 10
